bayts.text: I have turned my face, possessed of nearness to Allah, by the standing of Aḥmad, possessed of longing for Allah.
Allah is greater than what I used to do, and I neither fear nor hope in any but Allah.
My remembrance, my gratitude, my good pleasure and my praise, with heart, body and pens, are for Allah.
All of me is for Him — exalted be He — in secret and in the open, and I ask none but the Benefactor, Allah.
The Benefactor, the Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), has nurtured me: I thank Him as long as I live with my saying: "Praise belongs to Allah".
He protected me from harm by way of honour and turned toward me a benefit without cause: so gratitude is for Allah.
Allah is greater than what I used to seek, and from Him I seek my being the slave of Allah.
Allah is greater than my creed and my deeds and my word: all of me has become Allah's.
His is the Existence that pre-eternity has already adorned, with permanence; and what is other than Allah belongs to Allah.
His are the creatures, His are their deeds, and His is what He chose forever: the affair belongs to Allah.
He is the Generous Whose honouring I seek, and His being for me is my hope with Allah.
My triumph tomorrow is His being for me forever, and to Him I entrust my affair, through the Chosen, by Allah!
My hand and my heart are His, His intimate forever, possessed of service to the Messenger of Allah, through Allah.
the purest blessing with peace, beyond number, upon him, with the Family and the Companions, from Allah.
O Lord, bless and grant peace forever, out of generosity, upon my supreme means of access to Allah.
O Lord, bless with peace my support, the one through whom I have been content in obedience to Allah.
I mean Muḥammad, the Chosen of Muḍar, with the Family and the Companions, the party of the King, Allah.
Muḥammad is my shield against the reckoning tomorrow, and my garden in the Gardens of the All-Embracing, Allah.
Give me possession this year of what surpasses the wishes, out of generosity, O Enricher of every needy one (turning) to Allah.
Bless him and grant peace, and fulfil my purpose through him, and drive to me what I hope from Allah.
I have called upon You today, in the (sacred) days, hoping for the reward of whoever made the pilgrimage to the House of the Provider, Allah.
Turn toward me this year, O Enricher without burdens, unveiling, folding (of the path) and enabling grace from Allah.
My religion is Your Book: teach it to me, O my Eternal Refuge, through unveiling and outpouring, possessed of understanding from Allah.
Make it for me forever a light by which I attain clarity, nearness and glad tidings with Allah.
Fulfil my wish and make life clear, O my Eternal Refuge, and be for me forever, and set me with Allah.
